title: SSC CHSL Tier 2 Descriptive — 18 Sep 2022
subTitle: Official Descriptive Paper (Pen & Paper Mode, 100 Marks)

questions.questionText:
Write an essay in English on the following topic:
"Freedom of Speech and the Modern Youth: Navigating Digital Distractions in an Enticing World"
questions.explanation: Descriptive writing evaluation based on relevance, structure, vocabulary, and argument coherence.
questions.modelSolution:
Today's youth inhabit a hyper-connected digital universe brimming with unprecedented opportunities and relentless
temptations. Digital platforms and social media have revolutionized the way young people express opinions, exercise freedom
of speech, and mobilize around critical global causes. Never before has the power of expression been so accessible,
instantaneous, and widespread.
However, this vast digital landscape is a double-edged sword. With algorithms engineered to maximize user engagement,
young minds are constantly subjected to endless dopamine triggers, digital validation, and superficial content. As a result,
critical thinking and deep focus are increasingly compromised by shortened attention spans and algorithmic rabbit holes. The
temptation of constant social media scrolling often distracts students and young professionals from academic rigor, career
preparation, and meaningful offline interactions.
Furthermore, freedom of speech is frequently distorted by online echo chambers, cyberbullying, and unverified viral trends,
leading to cognitive fatigue and mental distress.
To navigate this alluring yet perilous environment, young individuals must cultivate digital discipline and media literacy.
Freedom of expression finds its true value not in reactionary online noise, but in informed, constructive dialogue. Balancing
virtual engagement with purposeful real-world action is vital for today's youth to harness technology without becoming its
captive.
rubrics: Relevance to Topic & Conceptual Clarity (15 Marks)
Structure, Coherence & Flow of Ideas (15 Marks)
Adherence to Word Limit & Format Guidelines (10 Marks)

questions.questionText:
Write a formal letter / application to the local civic authorities addressing persistent community issues
regarding public sanitation, street lighting, and civic safety in your neighborhood.
questions.explanation: Formal letter evaluation based on official format, civic address, conciseness, and tone.
questions.modelSolution:
Sector 4, Rohini,
New Delhi - 110085.

18th September, 2022.

The Executive Engineer (Sanitation & Maintenance),
Municipal Corporation of Delhi,
Rohini Zone, New Delhi.

Subject: Persistent issues regarding public sanitation, malfunctioning street lighting, and civic safety.

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to draw your prompt attention to the deteriorating civic amenities in Sector 4, Rohini.

For the past several weeks, municipal garbage collection has become irregular, resulting in overflowing community bins and unsanitary conditions. Stagnant waste poses severe health hazards, especially during the monsoon season. Additionally, over half the streetlights along Main Road 12 remain dysfunctional, compromising neighborhood security and increasing vulnerability to night-time accidents.

I earnestly request your department to ensure daily waste collection and initiate immediate repair of the faulty street lighting network. Regular sanitation drives and periodic inspections will greatly enhance the health, safety, and well-being of the local community.

Thanking you.

Yours faithfully,
A Concerned Resident
